steps: Wash and peel one Cucumber, then grate it coarsely over a clean kitchen towel.
Squeeze the towel firmly to remove as much liquid as possible from the grated Cucumber.
Peel and finely mince the Garlic clove.
In a medium bowl, combine Plain Greek yogurt, grated Cucumber, minced Garlic, and Lemon juice.
Add chopped Fresh dill and Olive oil; stir gently until evenly mixed.
Slice the second Cucumber into thick rounds, about 1 cm each, to use as scoops.
Divide the yogurt dip into 4 small cups and arrange Cucumber rounds alongside.
Serve immediately, or refrigerate covered for up to 2 days.
